# One-paragraph summaries
Summary: Halfmage is the registered business of Gerrit Halfmann, a solo creative technologist offering design, development, and SEO/GEO optimization. One person, no handoffs, no overhead. Working with funded startups, SMEs, and companies across Europe and the US since 2005. Selected work includes Camino Network, Chain4Travel, and Sleap.io.

Pricing: Remake + Visibility from €9,999 (one-time); Design + Development from €7,999/mo; Design Only from €3,999/mo.
Differentiators: Solo operator. Faster decisions, zero broken telephone, coherent product where design and architecture talk to each other. Also builds own products (Pixelarticons, Majesticons, VeryNiceView, AskMention, LearnSlice).
